title.narrative: Climate Change Impact on Ocean & Coastal Ecosystems

description.narrative: This programme focuses on accessing data and generating and sharing the scientific knowledge required to understand climate-driven changes in ocean systems. It includes norms and methodological standards, global datasets, and policy-tailored knowledge products that advance understanding of interacting and cumulative climate stressors and the identification of mitigative and adaptive measures for addressing climate change. supports the value of collaborations, networks and connections that can support information and capacity exchange and sharing of practices, technologies and infrastructure with a focus on ocean–climate research. It provides resources and learning opportunities that can advance and expand global and regional research collaboration and grow research networks.
